tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are a university student living in a dormitory. Recently, you have noticed that the internet connection in your dormitory is very slow and often disconnects. This issue is making it difficult for you to complete your assignments and attend online classes. You want to report this problem to the dormitory manager, Mr. Evans, and request a solution. Write an email to Mr. Evans.
bullets: Describe the issue with the internet connection.
Explain how this problem is affecting your studies.
Request that the internet connection be improved as soon as possible.
tasks.subject: Internet connection issues in dormitory
